pares.citacao: 'The nomenclature for concrete strength from the Eurocode consists of a capital C followed by two compressive strengths, one measured using concrete cylinder test specimens and the other using concrete cube specimens (e.g., C25/30) [15]'; 'concrete strengths considered for cast in situ piles were C20/25, C25/30, and C30/37, complying with NEN-EN 1536:2010+A1:2015 [32]'
pares.nota: fck 20 = primeiro numero de C20/25 (cilindro). Sistema misto: vigas pre-fabricadas C40/50. Sem ensaio proprio.

pares.norma: EHE-08 (citada para resistencias minimas e dosagem)
pares.citacao: 'The Royal Decree 1247/2008 [34], hereinafter EHE-08, establishes the recommended minimum strengths based on durability requirements... These data have been taken as a reference for the calculation of the dosage'; 'assuming a constant compression strength of 35 N/mm2'
pares.nota: DUVIDOSO: o 35 N/mm2 e hipotese de calculo da regressao (base IVE de 1.505 betoes, resistencias em N/mm2). A EHE-08 e citada para a dosagem/resistencias minimas, nao explicitamente para definir o 35; nao ha notacao HA-xx no texto. Se aceite, EHE-08 define fck em cilindro 150x300.

pares.citacao: 'the production process of reinforced concrete is modelled according to the "Concrete 40 MPa, 30% fly ash, at the batching plant" in the AusLCI database'
pares.nota: Classe de catalogo AusLCI, sem norma nem provete citados (nenhuma referencia a AS 1379/AS 1012).

pares.citacao: Ref.[41] 'EN 12390-3:2019 Testing hardened concrete - Part 3: Compressive strength of test specimens'; Tabela 4: Destructive Force F [kN] 1533.6 / Breaking stress fci 68.2 MPa ... ; 'over 71 MPa (C55/67)'
pares.nota: Dimensoes nao declaradas no texto. Inferido pela Tabela 4: F/fci = 1533,6 kN / 68,2 MPa = 22.487 mm2 ~ 150x150 mm (todas as 12 leituras dao ~22.500 mm2) -> cubo 150 mm (vol 0,003375 m3). A classificacao 71 MPa -> C55/67 tambem indica valor de cubo. Fig.14 refere 'cubik' e 'cylinder' so para tracao por compressao diametral.

pares.citacao: 'The NSC covers the C25, C35 and C45 classes. The mix proportion for NSC is designed conforming to BS EN206-1 [46]. For example, 1 m3 of C28/35 concrete comprised 300 kg of cement' ([46] = BS 8500-1, complementar a BS EN 206-1)
